verdicts.reason: Both reflow the quote into a narrow column with bad wrapping: 'to' sits alone on its own line, 'men.' and 'have done it well.' keep the original hard breaks, and the attribution is indented off the text's left edge with dead space below it. A also shrinks the ram skull to a tiny thumbnail and pushes it left, and the yellow bar no longer crosses the skull the way it does in the original. B keeps the skull larger and closer to the original's yellow-bar overlay, so it stays more faithful, but it has the same typesetting problems.
